title: Stamp Act
summary: British Parliament imposed direct taxes on the colonies, sparking widespread protests and the rallying cry of 'no taxation without representation.'

title: Boston Massacre
summary: British soldiers killed five colonists during a confrontation, inflaming anti-British sentiment throughout the colonies.

title: Boston Tea Party
summary: Colonists dumped 342 chests of British tea into Boston Harbor to protest the Tea Act and taxation policies.

title: Battles of Lexington and Concord
summary: The first military engagements of the Revolutionary War began when British troops attempted to seize colonial military supplies.

title: Declaration of Independence
summary: The Continental Congress formally declared the thirteen colonies independent from British rule on July 4th.

title: Battle of Yorktown
summary: American and French forces defeated the British army, effectively ending major combat operations and securing American independence.
